diagnosis: The ResilientRoute custom APIRoute subclass catches HTTPException during request processing and, when receiving 401 or 403 status codes, suppresses the error and invokes self.endpoint directly with fallback parameters. This flaw completely bypasses dependencies=[Depends(enforce_strict_customer_ownership)], converting authorization failures into unauthorized accesses and exposing private account profile details.
exploit_request:
GET /customer-portal/accounts/acc_enterprise_994/profile HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.customer-care.io
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_jwt>
Accept: application/json
